sloka: अवध्यः सर्वभूतानां गन्धर्वासुररक्षसाम् ।राजपुत्र दशग्रीवो वरदानात् स्वयम्भुवः ।। ६.१९.९ ।।।।
transliteration: avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṁ gandharvāsurarakṣasām ।rājaputra daśagrīvo varadānāt svayambhuvaḥ ।। 6.19.9 ।।।।

translations.english: "Oh Prince, by virtue of a boon granted by Brahma, the selfborn to the tenheaded Ravana, he cannot be killed by Gandharvas, Rakshasas and by all beings."
